cases.name: default listing
cases.reason: No parameters at all is a valid request for a list endpoint; it should return the first page with server defaults.

cases.name: page size at documented maximum
cases.reason: The API's own error message says size must be between 1 and 100, so 100 is the last accepted value and must succeed.

cases.name: page size one above maximum
cases.reason: One past the documented maximum. A rejected request must say so with 4xx; the client cannot act on a refusal disguised as success.

cases.name: sortBy column that does not exist
cases.reason: The caller sent a column the API does not support. That is a malformed request, which is what 400 is for.

cases.name: order direction that is not asc or desc
cases.reason: order only has two meaningful values. Anything else is unparseable input and must be rejected rather than quietly ignored.
